annotations.title: Draft the llms.txt of a website

description: Builds an llms.txt for a website from facts read on it — the site name and description from its home page, then pages from its sitemap with their titles and meta descriptions, grouped by section — and reviews the existing llms.txt if there is one (declared name, links, claims no machine can verify). The draft is ready to edit and publish at /llms.txt. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants
